name: s81lk_kp4_ddly
structural_change: S81-TILES2 10-17: four-tile re-split of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (replaces s81lk_kp4_deca / decb, REJECTED at their CTS gates: 259.2 um tiles, SRAM in the middle, clock on the S face; TT insertion 307-455 / 295-417 ps, spread 148 / 122 ps).  Cluster 2 x 2: dsyn SW (PMA in W), ddly NW, dchn SE, dout NE (beats out E); every seam registered at both pins.  Bit-exact vs the 33a35eb7d two-tile decoder on every output and cycle (tb_s81_kp4_eq: RTL same cycle, hardware view with all tile pin registers = reference + 2 cycles; mutants DMUT 2 / 3 and a one-short word seam FAIL).  ddly: the 64 x 546 received-word SRAM delay (DD = 55, free-running pointer) alone; macro at (43.2, 43.2) MY on the 43.2 lattice against the N face (20.5 um channel), one std-cell band S (41 um) holding the w_d pin registers; MY puts the read port and half the write port on the macro's E edge beside the r_d face.  w_d full S face (from dsyn, 2.3/um), r_d full E face (to dout, 3.9/um), clk W face beside the S band.  ~1.1k sinks.  Aspect 1.69 is the macro's (178.6 x 81) plus the 20 um channels; a single-macro delay tile.

job.purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder tile ddly (received-word SRAM delay) of the 4-tile cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec, 10-17. Bench = cluster equivalence vs 33a35eb7d and the one-short word-seam mutant.
